subject: Production tail-latency spike + 5xx wave — immediate escalation
messages:
From: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finpulse.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production tail-latency spike and 5xx errors — urgent

Monica,

We're seeing a sustained spike in tail latency and a correlated 5xx wave across our inference requests starting ~07:55 PT. Impact:
- P95/P99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~450ms to 3–8s for ~30% of requests.
- 5xx rate increased from 0.2% to ~4.5% in the last 20 minutes.
- Errors cluster on route: model=redwood-medium, seq_len=2048, batch size ~8.

This is happening during our busiest window and is causing user-facing errors in our payments flow. We're on a reserved capacity plan and expected predictable throughput — this looks like throttling/backpressure. Can you confirm whether Dedicated GPU pools are oversubscribed or if there's a routing/fallback issue?

I've attached a short sample of error logs and traces. We're happy to jump on a bridge; this is blocking our production traffic.

Attachments: finpulse-error-samples.log.txt

Julia Hart
Head of SRE, FinPulse
julia.hart@finpulse.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finpulse.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production tail-latency spike and 5xx errors — urgent

Julia — thanks for the alert and the logs. I'm very sorry you're hitting this. We're treating this as an escalation and have looped in Rishi (account), Grace (CS), and Vivek (infra) to triage immediately.

Immediate plan:
- Stand up a short bridge (15-30m) to share traces and determine if this is reserved pool headroom or a runtime regression.
- Share our MAP (mutual action plan) while we triage and keep you informed at 15-minute cadence.

Can you confirm the HubSpot deal ID (I have HS-52314) and whether you want us to prioritize failures over latency (i.e., favor fewer 5xx by reducing concurrency)? Also: are you running any recent model pin/override that might route differently?

I attached a blank MAP template and will turn this into a worked plan after the bridge.

Attachments: finpulse-map-20270328.xlsx

— Monica Patel

monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production tail-latency spike and 5xx errors — infra observations

Quick infra summary from initial checks (ops at 08:34 PT):
- Dedicated GPU pool for FinPulse (pool-id: dp-finpulse-7) shows sustained slot utilization at ~98% for the last 12 minutes; queue depth increased sharply at 07:56 PT.
- Kernel/sequence-length distribution changed vs baseline (more long-context requests hitting same workers), increasing KV-cache pressure and triggering worker-level backpressure that surfaces as 5xx on the front-end router.
- There is a small but material number of cross-tenant spillovers due to a misconfigured autoscaling policy on one node group (we identified two pods with excessive non-FP requests).

Immediate mitigations we can enact within 10–20 minutes:
1) Apply a temporary route-weight shift: demote non-priority routes to burst pool and prioritize your reserved routes.
2) Enable a soft-cap on concurrent long-context requests for the affected variant (low-friction runtime flag).
3) If authorized, allocate short-term burst capacity from shared capacity (estimated cost: $1.8k/hr) until autoscaler fix finishes (~2–4 hours).

I'll join the bridge. Attaching the qps/slot-level export we pulled.

Attachments: infra-qps-metrics-20270328.csv

— Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Serving & Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production tail-latency spike and 5xx errors — customer sensitivity and commercial ask

Team — FYI, FinPulse is in the middle of a payments pilot and any user-facing errors will materially impact PS rollout. They are extraordinarily sensitive to sustained 5xx and have a standby exec (CTO) watching.

Two asks from my side:
- Approve short-term burst allocation (Vivek estimated $1.8k/hr) while we fix autoscaling. I'll commit to a throttled authorization boundary (max 6 hours) if IH approves.
- Prepare a customer-facing summary for the CTO and VP Product at FinPulse. I opened HS-52314 with the incident notes and will link the public bridge.

Naomi — can you sign off on the temporary credit/authorization for burst capacity? FinPulse will likely request a credit for downtime if the impact persists.

— Rishi Malhotra

Date: Tue, 29 Mar 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production tail-latency spike and 5xx errors — mutual action plan and next steps

Julia — follow-up after today's bridge and infra remediation. Summary / MAP:

What happened (short):
- Oversubscription and autoscaler misconfig led to slot exhaustion in dp-finpulse-7 during peak, increasing queue depth and KV pressure and generating 5xxs on the front-end router.

Actions taken (completed):
- Demoted non-priority routes to burst pool (08:50 PT).
- Enabled soft-cap on long-context concurrency (09:03 PT).
- Hotfix to autoscaler config rolled at 12:15 PT to prevent cross-tenant spillover.
- Short-term burst capacity assigned from shared pool 09:00–15:00 PT (controlled authorization).

Pending / next steps:
- Engineering post-mortem scheduled (Vivek) by 2027-04-01 with a remediation timeline for autoscaler policy enforcement and improved per-tenant isolation.
- Commercial: Rishi + Naomi to propose a goodwill credit if SLA thresholds were violated; draft due 2027-03-30.
- Ops: We'll provide a 30-day elevated monitoring window and daily health checks for FinPulse routes.

Bridge notes and MAP attached (finalized). We'll keep the customer update to a single exec summary for the CTO and a technical appendix for SREs.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-finpulse-20270329.pdf

Next actions for today:
- Rishi: commercial note and credit proposal (ETA 03/30).
- Vivek: post-mortem kickoff and draft remediation plan (ETA 04/01).
- Grace: weekly check-in cadence with FinPulse SRE (start 03/30).

Julia — please confirm that the immediate mitigations restored traffic for your users; if you're seeing any residual errors ping me and I'll escalate to execs immediately.

Thanks,
— Monica Patel
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
